Me and my friend Bill who was a server admin decided we had enough of her attitude. How likely is this package to get seized?

Not very likely within the EU. I have no experience ordering to countries in the south, but have never heard of customs being tougher there than anywhere else. Ordering from for example Netherlands, Belgium and the U.K. poses a greater risk than ordering from for example Germany, France or Switzerland. Ordering from a so-called high risk country to countries that are known for tough customs poses an even greater risk. Also keep in mind that in general, postal companies make no guarantees for delivery across borders as they might do domestically, therefore it might take much longer or much shorter than expected. Your friend ought to contact the vendor and ask about it, from anyone else you will only get guesses.
